selection: All hero-match observations across frozen same-day D2PT listings: 7.42, ranked pos 1, numeric account and match-average MMR >=7000; no win, duration, item or unique-account filter.

format.points: First actual samples >= 5/10/15/20 min, reached boundaries only. t=game seconds, lane=m_iCreepKillGold, neutral=m_iNeutralKillGold, lh=m_iLastHitCount; includes owned units. No terminal substitution.
events: spawn camp ID / lane of origin / ? unresolved
format.firstHeld: First second-sampled observation in main slots 0–5, not purchase or delivery time.
format.startPoint: First nonnegative sampled frame; same t/lane/neutral/lh keys as points.
format.endPoint: Actual terminal frame, even in games shorter than 20 minutes. Full/truncated window rates use measured elapsed time.
